_finding: KyberSwap's answer is untrusted input (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §3.2, outside review of #266): a quote is held to exactly the tokens and the amount asked, in its summary and along its route, amounts are decimal strings, a missing number stays null and only a 4xx says no route; a built swap is decoded and held to the stable, the token, the wallet and the amount, and one we cannot decode is not run.

mutations.name: the tokenIn / tokenOut check is removed
mutations.find: if (low(rs.tokenIn) !== low(tokenIn) || low(rs.tokenOut) !== low(tokenOut)) return { result: 'unknown', reason: 'quote_mismatch', source: 'kyberswap', quotedAt: at }
mutations.expect: FAIL a quote for another token is quote_mismatch

mutations.name: the amountIn check is removed
mutations.find: if (!isUnits(rs.amountIn) || rs.amountIn !== String(amountIn)) return { result: 'unknown', reason: 'quote_mismatch', source: 'kyberswap', quotedAt: at }
mutations.expect: FAIL a sell-back for another amount is quote_mismatch

mutations.name: the amountOut > 0 check is removed
mutations.expect: FAIL an amountOut of zero is quote_empty

mutations.name: a JSON number is taken as base units
mutations.expect: FAIL an amountOut sent as a JSON number

mutations.name: the route's own hops are not checked
mutations.find: const bad = routeProblem(rs, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn)
mutations.expect: FAIL a route whose last hop delivers another token

mutations.name: the build's output token is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a build for another output token

mutations.name: the build's recipient is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a build for another recipient

mutations.name: an undecodable build is run
mutations.find: if (!desc) return { ok: false, reason: 'build_unverified', to: low(tx.routerAddress) }
mutations.replace: if (!desc) return { ok: true, to: low(tx.routerAddress), data: String(tx.data).toLowerCase(), payTo: null, desc: null }
mutations.expect: FAIL a build with an entry point we do not decode is not run

mutations.name: a 5xx saying "no route" is read as no route
mutations.find: const NO_ROUTE = (r) => r.status >= 400 && r.status < 500 && r.status !== 429 && r.body &&
mutations.expect: FAIL a 5xx that says "no route" is an outage

mutations.name: a missing gasUsd becomes zero
mutations.expect: FAIL a missing gasUsd stays null

mutations.name: a swap build without executor data is run
mutations.find: if (desc.entry === 'swap' && !(BigInt(desc.executorBytes) > 0n)) return { ok: false, reason: 'build_unverified', to: low(tx.routerAddress) }
mutations.expect: FAIL a swap build with no executor data

mutations.name: a zero dstReceiver is refused
mutations.expect: FAIL a build that pays msg.sender

mutations.name: a hop without addresses is chained
mutations.expect: FAIL two adjacent hops with no intermediate address

mutations.name: a 429 is not busy
mutations.find: if (r.busy || r.status === 429) return { result: 'unknown', reason: 'aggregator_busy', source: 'kyberswap', quotedAt: null }
mutations.replace: if (r.busy) return { result: 'unknown', reason: 'aggregator_busy', source: 'kyberswap', quotedAt: null }

mutations.name: no route is read from a message
mutations.expect: FAIL a 4xx saying "no route" without the documented code

mutations.name: a negative gasUsd is kept
mutations.expect: FAIL a negative gasUsd is null

mutations.name: the build's amount is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a build for another input amount

mutations.name: a partial-fill build is accepted
mutations.expect: FAIL a build with the partial-fill flag
